meta.descripcion: Bank of complex English words, with an easy-read meaning and a real-life example. Own content (not a translation of content/dictionary/es.json — see doc/en/I18N.md §3).
meta.fuente: Words chosen from CEFR C1/C2 advanced English vocabulary lists (esl-lounge, Espresso English, Cambridge word lists) and, for vocabularies tied to people with intellectual disability, from established Easy-Read publishers used in the field: Inclusion Europe 'Information for All', Beyond Words / Books Beyond Words, CHANGE / Photosymbols, Makaton, Widgit / Widgit Health, People First (UK), Learning Disability England, Values into Action, SARTAC, Green Mountain Self-Advocates, CEC and TASH self-determination curricula, Special Olympics Healthy Athletes, AAIDD terminology guide, NHS England and gov.uk Easy-Read, CDC Easy-Read, and the Australian NDIS Easy-Read corpus. Definitions and examples written from scratch in easy-read style for Routime, not copied from any source.
meta.estado: Standalone content bank, not yet wired into any activity. tools/dictionary/data.js holds the subset already used by the Dictionary activity (24 words); this file is a broader base for that or future activities.

campos.definition: easy-read meaning: short sentence, one idea
campos.example: example sentence in a real adult-life context

words.definition: Costs an amount you can pay without trouble.
words.example: This flat is affordable: it costs less than others nearby.

words.definition: Easy to use, at a good time or place.

words.definition: Something you can trust, it does not fail.

words.definition: Can change easily to fit new needs.

words.definition: Lasts a long time without breaking.

words.definition: Done carefully, checking every part.

words.definition: Useful and simple, without extra trouble.

words.definition: Easy to reach or use for everyone.

words.definition: Just the right amount, enough for what is needed.

words.definition: Happens little by little, not all at once.

words.definition: Done suddenly, without planning ahead.

words.definition: Useful for many different things.

words.definition: Can really be done, it is possible.

words.definition: Real, not a copy or a fake.

words.definition: Clean and in order, everything in its place.

words.definition: Not required, you can choose it or not.

words.definition: Something done the same way, again and again.

words.definition: Makes sense and is not too much.

words.definition: Can be known before it happens.

words.definition: Makes you feel good, without any trouble.
words.example: This armchair is very comfortable for watching TV.

words.definition: Needs to be done now, it cannot wait.
words.example: The call was urgent: there was a problem at work.

words.definition: Done because someone wants to, not because they're forced.

words.definition: Sees the good side of things.

words.definition: Sees the bad side of things.

words.definition: Likes to share what they have with others.

words.definition: Doesn't boast about what they have or do.
words.example: She's humble: she never talks about her awards.

words.definition: Acts fast, without thinking first.
words.example: He was impulsive: he bought the car without checking the price.

words.definition: Thinks carefully before acting, to avoid problems.
words.example: She was cautious: she looked both ways before crossing.

words.definition: Wants to learn new things all the time.
words.example: He's curious: he always asks how things work.

words.definition: Recovers well after something hard happens.
words.example: She was resilient: she tried again after the failure.

words.definition: Prefers to be alone or with few people.
words.example: He's introverted: he likes staying home reading.

words.definition: Enjoys being around people and talking a lot.
words.example: She's outgoing: she knows everyone at the party.

words.definition: Feels emotions easily.
words.example: He's sensitive: he cries watching sad films.

words.definition: Feels sorry for others' pain and wants to help.

words.definition: Treats people well, friendly when talking.

words.definition: Helps others without expecting anything back.

words.definition: Shows a lot of excitement about something.

words.definition: Won't change their mind even when told they're wrong.

words.definition: Likes to help other people.
words.example: He's helpful: he always helps carry the bags.

words.definition: Can be hurt easily, needs protection.

words.definition: Says what they think with respect, without fear.
words.example: She was assertive: she said she didn't like the plan without getting angry.

words.definition: Feels a soft, quiet sadness, like missing something.

words.definition: Happy and in a good mood most of the time.

words.definition: Feels worried or nervous about something that might happen.

words.definition: Thinks about how their actions affect others.

words.definition: The money you plan to spend on something.

words.definition: Money paid to the government by law.

words.definition: A set of rules that must be followed.

words.definition: An official paper asking for something.

words.definition: A group set up to do something, like a company or charity.

words.definition: A large organization, like the town hall or a hospital.

words.definition: The right and duty to live as part of a country.

words.definition: The set of laws in a country.

words.definition: A message telling people about something coming up, like a course.

words.definition: Money given by the government to help do something.
words.example: The group got a grant for the workshop.

words.definition: Organizing and running the tasks of something well.

words.definition: Can be kept going over time without causing harm.

words.definition: Work together with others to get something done.

words.definition: An explanation for why things happen, based on evidence.

words.definition: Something that happens in nature and can be observed.

words.definition: The kind of weather a place usually has over a long time.

words.definition: Machines and tools that help make things easier to do.

words.definition: Works with computers or screens, not on paper.

words.definition: Brings something new that didn't exist before.

words.definition: Depends on what each person thinks or feels.

words.definition: Cannot be touched or seen, it is an idea.

words.definition: Clear and real, not a vague idea.

words.definition: Originally from the place where it lives, not from elsewhere.

words.definition: How often something happens in a period of time.

words.definition: The place you want to reach.

words.definition: A way of planning support around what one person wants and needs.

words.definition: Basic things every person is entitled to just for being a person.
words.example: Freedom and respect are human rights.

words.definition: The value that every person has just for being a person, and that must be respected.
words.example: She was treated with dignity by all the staff.

words.definition: A person who speaks on your behalf or helps you defend your rights.
